Private Function Fetch(ByVal name As String) As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Fetch = CStr(CallByName(Application, name, VbGet))
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Fetch = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function Same(ByVal name As String) As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    CallByName Application, name, VbLet, CallByName(Application, name, VbGet)
    Same = "ok"
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Same = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("DisplayClipboardWindow")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("DisplayDocumentActionTaskPane")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("DisplayDocumentInformationPanel")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("DisplayExcel4Menus")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("DisplayRecentFiles")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("DisplayXMLSourcePane")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("ShowDevTools")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("ShowStartupDialog")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("UseClusterConnector")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("CommandUnderlines")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("DataEntryMode")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("DefaultSaveFormat")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("CanPlaySounds") & "|set:" & Same("CanPlaySounds")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("CanRecordSounds") & "|set:" & Same("CanRecordSounds")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("MathCoprocessorAvailable") & "|set:" & Same("MathCoprocessorAvailable")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("MouseAvailable") & "|set:" & Same("MouseAvailable")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("Ready") & "|set:" & Same("Ready")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("ArbitraryXMLSupportAvailable") & "|set:" & Same("ArbitraryXMLSupportAvailable")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("IsSandboxed") & "|set:" & Same("IsSandboxed")
    s = s & "@@@start=" & Fetch("RecordRelative") & "|set:" & Same("RecordRelative")
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
